paragraphs.text: Corundis (kohr-UN-diss) was an island nation surrounded by the Golthonor Sea in the region of Golthonor off of the mainland of Dominarian Corondor .
Once the most powerful in all of Corondor, now a dying civilization, starved for the riches of the West. It was connected to the mainland by Telemar City , and was home to Grenfell Mor of Golthonor .
